content:
maya: Heads up — AuroraMed reporting p99 token-generation spikes on dedicated pool-A. Customer says timeouts are hitting SLA thresholds. Oncall alerted.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-4567 — high p99 for auroramed ded-pool-A. Linked runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4567

priya: Customer notes the spike started after model rollout at 09:10 UTC (v2.1 -> v2.2). They didn't change their integration.

alex: Thanks. Alex from eng-platform — can someone confirm if v2.2 is in our catalog and whether it changed quantization/profile?

chris: Looking now. Early indication: v2.2 has longer avg context length in their workload which increases KV cache churn. I see elevated tail latencies on pool-A GPUs.

jen: Oncall here. Spinning up temporary capacity and enabling fallback routing to pool-B. ETA ~6m.

maya: Priorities: 1) immediate SLA mitigation (routing + capacity), 2) RCA & perf regression, 3) customer comms. Owners?

alex: I'll own 2) RCA + patch (eng-platform). Chris will help with runtime traces. Jen owns 1) (oncall). Priya for CS comms.

chris: Quick ask — we need a hotflag to disable v2.2 routing for AuroraMed only. Do we patch routing-policy config or toggle via console?

alex: We store per-customer routing overrides in s3: s3://catalog/overrides/auroramed.json. I can PR a change but that takes review. Jen, can you flip the per-tenant toggle from the console for immediate mitigation?

jen: I'll toggle now and report back. Command I use locally:
```
redwood-cli config set --tenant auroramed --routing.model_override "redwood/v2.1"
```
I'll post when complete.

jen: Toggled. Traffic is shifting back to v2.1. Metrics show p99 dropping from ~1.8s to ~1.1s on initial samples :thumbsup:

priya: I'll message the customer: "We've applied a routing override to route you back to v2.1 while we investigate v2.2. Expect measurable improvement within 10m."

maya: Alex, what do you need for RCA? Any blocked PRs or traces?

alex: Need perf profiles and KV cache heatmaps from Chris. Also two small PRs: one to add a telemetry tag, one to tweak the kernel heuristic. I'll open them and tag @chris for review.

chris: I'll pull traces and attach to INC-4567. If kernel tweak looks promising, recommend a canary rollout to pool-C.

maya: Proposed timeline: short-term mitigation done (routing) now. Medium-term RCA + patch within 4 hours. Canary deploy window in ~2 hours if needed. Customer ok?

priya: Customer confirmed they accept the timeline and requested a postmortem afterwards. I'll set up a doc and share with their security/comms reps.

alex: Opening PRs now: PR#4821 (telemetry tag) and PR#4822 (kernel heuristic). Assigning @chris for review. Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 and /pull/4822

jen: If canary shows regression, I'll rollback via console immediately. DM me if you need a fast revert.

maya: I'll update leadership and the incident channel. Ping me if anyone needs help coordinating across teams.

priya: Scheduling a quick sync at 11:30 UTC in case we need live RCA review.

oncall-bot: Update: INC-4567 status changed to 'mitigated' by jen. Monitoring will continue for 2 hours.

chris: Uploaded traces to the ticket. Next steps: review PRs and prepare canary plan for pool-C if kernel change required.

alex: Will coordinate PR reviews and run canary tests. Assigning owners in the incident ticket and updating rollout checklist.

maya: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open for any follow-ups. End of thread.
